change: The upstream Resizer is mounted through ClientOnly and its fallback renders the sidebar child during SSR; the resizer attaches after hydration.
reason: The pinned upstream hook evaluates the browser-only document global during render, causing generated TanStack Start SSR to throw ReferenceError: document is not defined.
evidence: Generated-target SSR reproduced the error in @saas-ui-pro/react useResize while rendering AppSidebar; client-resizer.test.tsx renders the fallback with renderToString without throwing.

change: The resize handle receives role=separator and aria-orientation=vertical alongside its existing accessible label.
reason: The upstream component renders a div; aria-label on that div is prohibited without a valid role.
evidence: Paired axe run reported serious aria-prohibited-attr on .sui-resize-handle; shell.test.tsx asserts the generated sidebar source includes the separator role and orientation.

change: The generated web target sets exactOptionalPropertyTypes to false.
reason: The transplanted Starter/Saas UI source currently relies on optional component props that are not assignable under the repository-wide exact optional property contract.
evidence: At generated-target proof commit acbced929, enabling exactOptionalPropertyTypes=true after the production build produces 34 web type errors (28 TS2375 and 6 TS2379), primarily optional component props receiving undefined; the relaxed override remains required.

change: The generated web target sets noUncheckedIndexedAccess to false.
reason: The transplanted Starter/Saas UI source indexes registry and fixture collections without handling undefined values under the repository-wide indexed-access contract.
evidence: At generated-target proof commit acbced929, enabling noUncheckedIndexedAccess=true after the production build produces 13 web type errors (8 TS18048, 1 TS2322, 2 TS2345, and 2 TS2532), from unchecked collection/indexed values; the relaxed override remains required.

change: The upstream Stat.Root and Stat.Label for the chart/legend block render as div elements while retaining the upstream Stat styles and layout props.
reason: Chakra Stat.Root defaults to dl, but this block contains a chart div and legend ul rather than a dt/dd pair; the default markup triggers axe definition-list serious violations.
evidence: The pinned desktop authority artifact and generated desktop authority artifact both reported axe rule definition-list (serious) on <dl class="chakra-stat__root css-1pbhjgj"> with direct chart div and legend ul children; focused generated axe passed after the seam, and the pinned reference source was synchronized with the same minimal semantic change.

change: The factory provider composition supplies the generated QueryClient and fake-safe AuthProvider around the preserved Saas UI provider.
reason: The pinned Starter provider imports starter-owned auth and query clients; the factory must close those providers at the neutral adapter boundary so generated SSR and browser fixtures render without starter credentials.
evidence: app-provider.test.tsx verifies the provider composition with a real QueryClient and the reference authority launcher reaches Vite preview after the provider seam.

change: The browser-only upstream Resizer is replaced at both served factory call sites by the shared ClientResizer seam while preserving the upstream layout and resize-handle structure.
reason: The upstream Resizer evaluates browser globals during SSR; ClientResizer defers that behavior behind ClientOnly for generated TanStack Start SSR.
evidence: The receipt-backed adapted-file test hashes both served call sites, and the existing client-resizer SSR evidence covers renderToString without a document global.

change: The root route passes its route-context QueryClient into the adapted AppProvider.
reason: The factory provider seam requires the route-owned query client while preserving the upstream root document and shell composition.
evidence: The generated-target SSR provider test exercises the root composition and the reference authority launcher reaches preview startup.

change: The starter tRPC client is represented by a neutral recursive fake facade until generated refs replace it.
reason: Starter-specific tRPC credentials and client construction are not available in the factory; the facade keeps transplanted screens runnable with fake fixtures.
evidence: react.test.tsx verifies nested query/mutation access remains fake-safe, and the generated-target proof reaches the web build without a live tRPC client.

change: The preserved aside gains named open/close controls and restores focus to its trigger after close or Escape.
reason: The upstream Aside primitive exposes controlled open state but no close control or trigger relationship; the acceptance contract requires keyboard-close and focus restoration.
evidence: The paired golden interaction spec closes the contact details aside with Escape and asserts focus returns to the named trigger.

change: The upstream DataGrid is mounted through ClientOnly while retaining its original client-side JSX and styles.
reason: The column-resizer EnvironmentContext evaluates document during SSR, which crashes both reference and generated golden authorities.
evidence: data-grid.ssr.test.tsx reproduces ReferenceError: document is not defined for the vendor DataGrid with resizing enabled; the ContactsListPage SSR regression and paired desktop golden subset prove the boundary and hydrated grid.
